Definition: gathered, i.e. (abstractly) a gathering in of crops
BiblicalUsage: The Feast of Ingathering — asiyph is the gathering in of the harvest at the end of the year, when the labour of the fields was done and Israel kept the feast. It is named twice, both times in the giving of the feasts: firstfruits, harvest, and ingathering, the three great feasts of the year.
TheologicalSignificance: A harvest feast's name is a calendar fact, and the teaching is the feast itself, closing the year with thanks to the Lord who gave the crop.
